gateway.description: Hostname or IP address of the Fortinet SSL VPN gateway (required).

password.description: Password for the account. Leave empty to prompt at runtime (recommended for security).

ca_file.description: Path to CA certificate bundle for server validation. Use system bundle by default.

client_cert.description: Path to client certificate file (if using certificate authentication).

client_key.description: Path to client private key file (if using certificate authentication).

no_verify_ssl.description: Disable SSL certificate verification (⚠ insecure — only for testing).

local_ip.description: Static local IP address for the PPP interface (optional; if omitted, uses DHCP).

local_netmask.description: Netmask for the static local IP (e.g., 255.255.255.0).

set_routes.description: Automatically set routes to direct traffic through the tunnel (default). Set to false to disable.

add_routes.description: List of subnets to include in the tunnel (split tunneling).

exclude_routes.description: List of subnets to exclude from the tunnel (split tunneling).

dns_servers.description: DNS servers to push to the client. Overrides gateway-provided DNS if set.

proxy_host.description: Proxy server hostname or IP (if required to reach the VPN gateway).

ppp_mtu.description: PPP Maximum Transmission Unit size. Reduce if connection drops with fragmentation errors.

trusted_cert.description: SHA256 fingerprint of expected server certificate (for pinning; overrides CA validation).

interface.description: Interface name to use for the VPN (e.g., ppp0, vpn0).

post_up.description: Shell script or command to run after the VPN tunnel is established (e.g., firewall rules).

pre_down.description: Shell script or command to run before the tunnel is torn down.

idle_timeout.description: Idle timeout in seconds before disconnecting (0 = no timeout).
